text: Sankashti means 'the difficulty' — today is for facing what feels stuck in your life.
With Ganapati, who clears all obstacles, this day is about taking the first step, not about waiting.
You are invited to chant 'Om Gam Ganapataye Namaha', offer some durva grass and a little jaggery.
If it suits your home, you may also do the evening pooja after moonrise.
Think of one thing you've been putting off, and take the first small step on it today.
